title: Give OLY-A-12 a mechanism: surface changes need a design decision
summary: Extend the existing design-surface inventory (crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs) with a deterministic check that a change which adds, removes or alters the surface (commands, config keys, record schemas, roles, crates) also touches docs/decisions.md. Record it as OLY-A-12's mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml, backed by a test that fails without it. Audience: the Athena owner and verifier checking that the API is not treated as settled.

defaults_applied.how: Mechanism written in Rust inside athena-core.
Adds a unit test; fmt, clippy and test must pass.
One function and test in an existing module; no wiring.
Test checks both flagged and unflagged outcomes.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs (inventory_at, diff, SurfaceDiff::is_empty/totals, existing tests), crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs (pub mod design_surface), and crates/athena-core/src/status.rs STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS. Entry point is the pure function over a SurfaceDiff and a list of changed paths; no resolution or probing order applies. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file/AnyRecord are untouched. The property is measured directly via diff output, not a stand-in.
Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs (inventory_at, diff, SurfaceDiff) is extended, and docs/decisions.md is the design-decision log; docs/spec.toml holds the requirement.

Assumption: 'design decision' means an entry in docs/decisions.md in the same change; the mechanism is a library check, not yet wired into land or athena status, so the measure is `status: not shown` naming the test, since no status label fits.
Term ladder: not used in this reading.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml OLY-A-12 has mechanism naming the new function in crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs (Grep finds that function there), owner "Athena", and a measure ending `status: not shown` that names the test (cargo test -p athena-core design_surface).

Run `cargo test -p athena-core design_surface`: a new test passes showing that when diff(old,new) is non-empty and the changed paths exclude docs/decisions.md the new check reports the undecided surface changes, and when docs/decisions.md is among the paths, or the diff is empty, it reports none. The test fails if the function body is replaced by returning no findings.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo test --workspace`; all pass, including the xtask spec test that requires the measure marker.

Only docs/spec.toml, crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs and CHANGELOG.md change; no governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) and no record schema is added, so the check_record_file/AnyRecord round trip is unaffected. The check is not wired into landing or refusal, so no reading is newly refused (expected 0% of newly refused readings).

out_of_scope: Wiring the check into landing, admission or athena status output
Adding new record schemas or athena.toml keys
hard_reason: Adds a check that flags changes (a rule that can hold work), though it is only a library function, not wired into landing.
